cat rosterkit/models.py rosterkit/errors.py; head -30 tests/test_summary.py; cat tests/support.py | head -30

mkdir qa && cat > rosterkit/notices.py <<'EOF'
"""Plain-text notices for parents."""

from typing import Iterable

from rosterkit.attendance import days_missed
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student


def absence_notice(student: Student, marks: Iterable[Mark]) -> str:
    """Short notice naming the student, days missed and the dates in order."""
    marks = list(marks)
    if any(mark.student_id != student.student_id for mark in marks):
        raise ValueError("marks belong to a different student")
    days = days_missed(marks)
    if not days:
        raise ValueError("no absences to write about")
    count = len(days)
    noun = "day" if count == 1 else "days"
    dates = ", ".join(day.isoformat() for day in days)
    result = (
        f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name} missed {count} {noun}: {dates}."
    )
    return result
EOF
cat > qa/test_notices.py <<'EOF'
import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice

STUDENT = Student("1", "Lee", "Ana", "A")


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_absent_dates_in_order(self):
        marks = [
            Mark("1", date(2026, 3, 5), "absent"),
            Mark("1", date(2026, 3, 2), "absent"),
            Mark("1", date(2026, 3, 3), "present"),
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            absence_notice(STUDENT, marks),
            "Ana Lee missed 2 days: 2026-03-02, 2026-03-05.",
        )

    def test_single_day(self):
        marks = [Mark("1", date(2026, 3, 2), "absent")]
        self.assertIn("1 day:", absence_notice(STUDENT, marks))

    def test_other_students_marks_rejected(self):
        marks = [Mark("2", date(2026, 3, 2), "absent")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)

    def test_no_absences_rejected(self):
        marks = [Mark("1", date(2026, 3, 2), "excused")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)
EOF
